mobile.share_error_report_message: Sending this helps us find and fix problems like this one. It does not include your instance address, your login details, or anything that identifies you.
mobile.error_report_sent_message: If you'd like to file a bug report describing how this happened, open a discussion. Your reference is filled in already, so we can find this exact error occurrence.
mobile.error_report_sent_copy_hint: Copies the reference to your clipboard
mobile.error_reporting_always_description: Errors are sent to the developers automatically. They never include your instance address, your login details, or anything that identifies you.
mobile.error_reporting_ask_description: You are asked before each error is sent, and can see exactly what it contains first. Crashes that close the app are sent without asking, because the app is no longer running to ask you. Choose Never to stop those too.
mobile.error_reporting_never_description: Nothing is sent, including crashes that close the app.
mobile.help_error_reference_description: Include this reference when you report a problem, so we can find the error report you shared.
